newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - AEX technical outlook mainly firm.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - AEX technical outlook mainly firm.

text.p: Dutch chartists on Monday were broadly bullish on the AEX index for the coming week.
ING Barings said the AEX's technicals had improved sharply and that a solid close above 566 would indicate another buy signal and a test of resistance at 572.
Fibonacci Press said the intermediate term trend was still up but that the short term trend was nearing the end of its up-cycle so pressure on prices was foreseable this month.
ABN AMRO said the AEX had broken the medium term trading range between 546 and 565 and expected the index to attack the all-time high of 572.50 reached in June.
The AEX index ended at 566.05 points on Friday, 12.66 above the previous Friday. On Monday it closed 2.12 points higher at 568.17.

ING Barings - The internal technicals of the AEX have improved sharply. A solid close above the 566 will certainly indicate another buy signal and a test of resistance at 572. A move above 572 will prove that the underlying bull market should continue.

Market breadth indicators have reached new all time highs last week, which is an indication that there is enough leadership in the market to pull the AEX into uncharted territory. Strong volume coming in during the last three trading sessions, shows that the bulls are slowly awaking from their summer sleep.

Fibonacci Press - The intermediate term trend is still up, but the short term trend is nearing the end of its upcycle. So expect pressure on prices later this month, to well into October. Further price gains are expected, if resistance at 570 is taken out. If so expect first resistance around 580, and higher around 591. Only a drop below 555 implies that the short term trend change is already in force.

IRIS - Unless the market is able to take out the heavy 570-573 resistance area we expect a neutral to slightly bearish market for this week. There's no imminent danger for a collapse but if some serious supply pushes the index below support at 547 a further decline may be anticipated.

ABN AMRO - The AEX broke out from the medium term trading range between 546 and 565 and has resumed the long term uptrend. Within the coming days we expect the index to attack the all time highs at the 572.50 level. In case this level breaks, we expect the AEX to reach for prices above 600. This bullish outlook has been confirmed by increasing volumes. However we expect volatility to remain high and therefore we advise to maintain close exit stops. -- Amsterdam newsroom, +31 20 504 5000 (FAX 31-20-504-5040)
